<mxfile host="draw.io"> <diagram name="Storage Architecture" id="storage"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1400" pageHeight="700" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<!-- Workload pods --> <mxCell id="pods" value="Application Pods
(PVC requests)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="250" width="160" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Option A: Rook-Ceph --> <mxCell id="rook_box" value="Rook-Ceph (ENABLE_ROOK=true) — In-Cluster" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="30" width="540" height="250" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rook_op" value="Rook Operator
(rook-ceph ns)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ceph_mon" value="Ceph MON
(3 replicas)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="180" y="40" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ceph_mgr" value="Ceph MGR" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="300" y="40" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ceph_osd" value="Ceph OSD
(per raw disk)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="420" y="40" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ceph_mds" value="Ceph MDS
(CephFS)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="100" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ceph_rgw" value="Ceph RGW
(S3 Object)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="140" y="100" width="100" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Storage Classes from Rook --> <mxCell id="sc_rbd" value="ceph-block
(RBD SC)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="100" width="110" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sc_cephfs_rook" value="ceph-filesystem
(CephFS SC)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="145" width="110" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sc_obj" value="ceph-bucket
(Object SC)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="190" width="110" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Raw disks --> <mxCell id="disks" value="Raw Block Devices
(nvme0n1, sda)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=10;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="rook_box"> <mxGeometry x="420" y="100" width="100" height="60" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Option B: External CephFS --> <mxCell id="ext_box" value="CephFS CSI (ENABLE_CEPH=true) — External Ceph" style="swimlane;startSize=25;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="330" width="540" height="170" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="csi_driver" value="CephFS CSI Driver
(ceph-csi-cephfs ns)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ext_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="160" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sc_cephfs" value="cephfs (default SC)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ext_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="100" width="130" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sc_cephfs_ret" value="cephfs-retain" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ext_box"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="100" width="130" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- External Ceph cluster --> <mxCell id="ext_ceph" value="External Ceph Cluster
(Proxmox host)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=10;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="ext_box"> <mxGeometry x="390" y="50" width="130" height="70" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Consumers on right --> <mxCell id="consumers" value="Consumers" style="swimlane;startSize=22;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="900" y="80" width="200" height="420" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_thanos" value="Thanos
(S3 object store)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="35" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_cnpg" value="CloudNativePG
(block volumes)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="85" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_harbor" value="Harbor
(registry data)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="135" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_keycloak" value="Keycloak
(PostgreSQL)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="185" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_matrix" value="Matrix Synapse
(PostgreSQL)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="235" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_grafana" value="Grafana
(dashboards)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="285" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_alertmgr" value="Alertmanager
(state)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="consumers"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="335" width="160" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="e_pods_rook" edge="1" source="pods" target="rook_box" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_pods_rook_l" value="PVC" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_pods_rook"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_pods_ext" edge="1" source="pods" target="ext_box" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_pods_ext_l" value="PVC" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_pods_ext"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_osd_disks" edge="1" source="ceph_osd" target="disks" parent="rook_box" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_csi_ext" edge="1" source="csi_driver" target="ext_ceph" parent="ext_box" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_csi_ext_l" value="CephX auth" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_csi_ext"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_sc_consumers" edge="1" source="sc_rbd" target="consumers" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="685" y="148"/> <mxPoint x="685" y="290"/> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_sc_consumers_l" value="provisions PVs" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_sc_consumers"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
